en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a harbor scene with several traditional wooden sailing boats moored closely together. In the foreground, a man in traditional dress stands beside a long display of pottery: large amphora-style jars lined up in a row behind many smaller pots and jugs arranged on the ground. The scene appears to be a market or quay-side pottery stall. Printed captions in Latin characters and some Greek appear at the bottom, including the words "EGINE. POTERIE" and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr".
